units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:14">Sot. IX, 14</cite> <he>בפ׳ של אספסיינוס</he> during the Vespasian war; <he>בפ׳ של טיטוס</he> during the Titus war; <he>בפ׳ האחרון</he> during the last war (Hadrianic revolution); Tosef. ib. XV, 8 (missing in ed. Zuck.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:4">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> top <he>עד מתי אנו הורגין בפ׳ וכ׳</he> how long yet shall we slay one another in war?; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 3:27">Tosef. Ḥull. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 4:27">IV</cite>), 27, read: <he>פֵּילָמוֹס</he>, v. <cite ref="A02630"><he>אפונס</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>פּוֹלמוֹסָיוֹת</he>, <he>פּוּלְמְסָאוֹת</he>, <he>פּוּלְמְסָיוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 8:9">Par. VIII, 9</cite> (<cite ref="M01199"><he>מים</he></cite>) <he>המכזבים בפ׳</he> waters which are known to have failed in wars. Y. Erub. I, end, 19ᵈ <he>הרוגי פל׳</he> slain in battle (during a revolution). Y. Yoma V, 42ᵈ bot.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>כמה פ׳ עשה וכ׳</he> how many wars did Hadrian wage?; a. e.
